title: PAR-134 SUN CMC retention and documented DXF projection guard
mode: generated AC1024 DWG object-vector and ASCII/Binary DXF fast slice
scope: Retain source CMC method, RGB, flags, reserved index, and optional strings for SUN DWG colors
Replay representable C0-C3 CMC metadata using SUN's detached string stream
Refuse invalid or unsupported CMC values before DWG output
Constrain SUN DXF color output to the documented group-63 scalar projection and refuse lossy state

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: ODA specifies the generic R2004+ CMC envelope: reserved BS index, packed BL method/value, RC flags, and optional color-name/book TV strings. The reviewed local ODA copy contains no SUN-specific object field layout; this slice preserves the existing SUN field order and changes only CMC capture/replay.

autodeskSunDxf.finding: The SUN DXF reference lists group 63 as the color field and does not list group 421 or CMC name/book fields.

autodeskForeground.finding: Autodesk identifies 0xC5 as kForeground, ACI foreground as 7, and the isForeground predicate as true for either kForeground or kByACI with kACIForeground. This supports the narrowly scoped SUN group-63 scalar projection, not DWG C5 producer payload claims.

localCode.finding: DRW_Sun previously retained only scalar/truecolor fields, its DWG writer did not accept a detached string buffer, and its DXF writer emitted group 421 despite the SUN-specific Autodesk DXF table not listing that field.

productionSummary: Append SUN CMC provenance and normalized name/book state; parse bounded DWG CMC method, flags, reserved index, RGB, and optional strings.
Pass the detached DWG string buffer into the SUN encoder; validate metadata and write supported C0-C3 CMC with the existing method-aware writer.
Refuse nonrepresentable SUN DXF colors before record publication and emit only documented group 63; keep parsing group 421 for compatibility but refuse typed rewrite when it is present.
changes.publicApiOrLayoutNote: DRW_Sun has appended public CMC fields and its encoder adds a defaulted detached-string-buffer parameter. Source callers using the old arity remain compatible; the public class layout/signature changes and downstream binaries must rebuild.

generatedControls.wireWalk: An independent AC1024 cursor decodes C0-C3 reserved index, method/value, flags, optional strings, and subsequent SUN intensity/shadow fields.
generatedControls.parserRetention: Production parsing checks normalized scalar/RGB, method, flags, index, names/books, parent handle, and trailing SUN fields. An injected C5 method mutation checks retained identity without claiming producer semantics.
generatedControls.lifecycle: Copy, assignment, and reset retain or clear the appended CMC state.
generatedControls.failClosed: Generated DWG writes reject C5, unsupported methods, malformed flags/index, and missing detached storage for flagged-empty names before output. ASCII and Binary DXF controls admit documented scalar mappings and reject RGB, optional CMC names/flags, invalid metadata, unsupported methods, and the nonstandard group-421 state before publishing bytes.

evidenceLimits: Generated vectors establish local wire/parser/writer consistency, not independent DWG producer semantics for SUN CMC values.
The C5 mutation verifies source-method retention and fail-closed DWG rewrite only; it does not qualify C5 payload or optional-name behavior from an independent producer.
No persistent fixture, external producer, native CAD application, independent semantic route, full suite, or platform qualification was run.
No support claim was promoted. J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
